current.title: Advanced Natural Language Processing
current.institution: Iran University of Science and Technology
current.description: Comprehensive doctoral and graduate curriculum on foundational Transformer architectures, Large Language Model pre-training and instruction tuning, faithful Retrieval-Augmented Generation (FAIR-RAG), multi-hop reasoning, and parameter-efficient adaptation.
topics: LLM Pre-training, Instruction Tuning & Alignment (DPO, RLHF)
Multi-Hop Question Answering & Latent Space Reasoning

current.title: Computer Game Design
current.institution: Iran University of Science and Technology
current.description: Core software and architectural principles of interactive video game development: gameplay mechanics, real-time physics, 2D/3D collision detection, non-player character AI (behavior trees and state machines), narrative branching, and game production pipelines.
topics: Game AI: Finite State Machines & Behavior Trees
Narrative Design, Level Architecture & Player Experience

current.title: Trustworthy Machine Learning
current.institution: Iran University of Science and Technology
current.description: Rigorous algorithmic foundations for building safe, dependable, and transparent machine learning systems: adversarial robustness, algorithmic fairness, explainability, uncertainty quantification, and alignment in deep neural networks.
topics: Explainable AI (XAI): Feature Attribution & Post-hoc Explanations
Safety, Provenance & Alignment in Generative Foundation Models

archived.title: Introduction to Natural Language Processing
archived.institution: Iran University of Science and Technology
archived.description: Classical statistical and neural NLP, n-gram language models, part-of-speech tagging, named entity recognition, dependency parsing, and text classification.
topics: Vector Space Models & Word Embeddings (Word2Vec, FastText)

archived.title: Advanced Topics in Knowledge Engineering
archived.institution: Iran University of Science and Technology
